name: 2019-1c-recuperatorio
title: Fast Food Store Working Hours
description: Employees of a fast food store register weekly availability either as a weekday range with one time slot or as per-weekday time slots; a sheet answers whether the employee works at a given date-time (end hour excluded), and the store reports which hourly slots between 7:00 and 23:00 of a week nobody covers. The student must build the model from scratch with TDD.

design.notes: Two ways of declaring availability (weekday interval vs per-weekday) should be polymorphic working-hours objects answering includes:, and the uncovered-hours query is a nested date/hour traversal that should be expressed with intervals and select:/reject:/anySatisfy: over the employees' sheets.
